# Villa Adora Breakfast

> Breakfast with a view at Villa Adora in Bled, Slovenia: a daily buffet directly beside Lake Bled, open to hotel guests and outside visitors.

## Official website

- Homepage: https://adorabreakfast.com/
- Sitemap: https://adorabreakfast.com/sitemap.xml
- Reservation email: mailto:info@adorabreakfast.com
- Phone: tel:+38651603858

## Business facts

- Name: Villa Adora Breakfast
- Type: Breakfast buffet / food establishment
- Address: Cesta svobode 35, 4260 Bled, Slovenia
- Area: Bled, near Lake Bled
- Hours: Every day, 07:30–10:30
- Price: €35 per person
- Availability: Open to hotel guests and outside visitors
- Setting: Inside or outside depending on preference and weather; terrace, island-view table, pavilion, or sundeck
- Location: Directly beside Lake Bled, with views of the lake and Bled Island; approximately 10 minutes on foot from the centre of Bled
- Parking: On request in front of the house; Sokol parking may also be available, subject to availability
- Reservations: Recommended for weekends and holidays
